reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Sea Organisms
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. Deep sea creatures rely heavily on this phenomenon for survival in the pitch-black ocean depths where sunlight cannot penetrate. Many fish and jellyfish use bioluminescent signals for communication, finding mates, and attracting prey. Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep sea organisms possess some form of bioluminescence, making it one of the most common adaptations in the marine environment.

questions.q: According to the passage, why do deep sea creatures use bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 깊은 바다 생물들이 '의사소통, 짝짓기, 먹이 잡기'를 위해 생물발광을 사용한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What percentage of deep sea organisms have bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 문장에서 '약 90%의 깊은 바다 생물이 생물발광 능력을 가지고 있다'고 명시되어 있습니다.
본문에서 '햇빛이 침투할 수 없는 암흑의 대양 깊이'라고 명확히 설명하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has improved the quality of human life more than it has harmed it'? Use specific examples to support your opinion.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의 또는 반대)과 주요 아이디어 2-3개를 간단히 소개
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유와 구체적 사례 제시 (의료, 교육, 통신 등의 발전)
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유와 구체적 사례 제시 (사회적 연결, 경제 성장, 정보 접근성 등)
structure.conclusion: 주요 아이디어 재정리 및 최종 입장 재확인

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has significantly improved...
Furthermore, advancements in technology have enabled...
For example, the development of smartphones has...
On the other hand, one could argue that...
To summarize, the benefits outweigh the drawbacks because...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study in a group with others. Other people prefer to study alone. Which study method do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in a group because...
One reason is that group study helps me...
Additionally, when studying with others, I can...
sample_points: 그룹 스터디를 통해 다른 관점을 이해할 수 있고, 어려운 부분을 함께 해결할 수 있습니다.
그룹 스터디는 동기부여가 되며, 토론을 통해 개념을 더 깊이 있게 학습할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Campus Library Services
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm new to campus and I'm not sure how to use the library. Librarian: Welcome! I'd be happy to help. Our library offers many services beyond books. We have computers, study rooms, and access to online databases. Student: That sounds great! Can I borrow books immediately? Librarian: Yes, once you get your student ID, you can borrow up to 20 books at a time for three weeks. We also offer a 24-hour study area on the third floor. Student: Perfect! Do you have research consultants? Librarian: Absolutely. You can book a consultation with our research specialists for free. They can help you find credible sources for your papers. Student: Excellent. I think I have everything I need. Librarian: Great! Feel free to visit us anytime. We're open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 10 PM.

questions.q: What services does the library provide according to the librarian?
options: Books, computers, study rooms, and online databases
questions.explanation: 사서가 '책 외에도 컴퓨터, 스터디룸, 온라인 데이터베이스 접근 등 많은 서비스를 제공한다'고 설명했습니다.

questions.q: How many books can a student borrow at one time?
questions.explanation: 사서가 '학생 ID를 받으면 한 번에 최대 20권을 빌릴 수 있다'고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: What is the purpose of booking a consultation with research specialists?
options: To get help finding credible sources for papers
questions.explanation: 사서가 '연구 전문가와의 상담은 논문을 위한 신뢰할 수 있는 출처를 찾는 데 도움을 주기 위한 것'이라고 설명했습니다.
